name: Kijima Saki
source:
Likes: Coffee, maid outfits, making small accessories, Wataru, her grandmother
Dislikes: Men touching her, adult videos

Saki is Wataru's maid and his employee for the video rental shop. She is significantly older than Wataru and lives with him in his video rental store. Her biggest fear is that Wataru will start watching porn when he reaches puberty, which he denies. She takes a mixture of a servant and elder sister role to Wataru, often changing from being subservient to scolding him depending on the situation.

[From [url=http://hayatenogotoku.wikia.com/wiki/Saki_Kijima]Hayate no Gotoku Wiki[/url]]
